about: GPT image gold examples (codex-image-gen skill, gpt-6-luna relay), each with an old-game texture under Art/Models/GridMaps as its style reference. Raw generations resized to 1024 px RGBA, not yet made tileable. Used as on-target training examples for the house style LoRA (Den #9420) and as candidate textures.

lava.spec: Seamless tileable ground texture for a stylized volcanic cave floor in a first-person game: cracked dark basalt plates of varied sizes with narrow glowing orange-yellow lava running in the cracks between them. Style: match the reference image's hand-painted toon style exactly - bold dark ink outlines, flat cel-shaded fills with a soft pale inner highlight, clean graphic shapes. Square 1024x1024. Even density edge to edge with no focal point, no rows or grid, no symmetry, flat even lighting, viewed straight down with no perspective. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. NO text, NO frames or borders, NO vignette. Colours: near-black and charcoal rock, hot orange and yellow lava.
